title: Release Day

pre.en: What surprised the team at the end?
pre.zh: 最后，什么事让团队很意外？
options: Arjun had to cancel his dinner.
The client didn't like the app.
Marketing had told everyone about the app a day early.

intro: 发版日的团队群聊：大家一边等测试、等 QA，一边盯着上线时间。读的时候留意时间状语从句：as soon as …、when …、until …、before … 说的都是将来的事，从句里却用一般现在时，will 只出现在主句里。最后别错过市场部的那条消息。

sentences.en: Morning, all — it's release day!
sentences.zh: 大家早——今天发版！
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: We'll go live as soon as Arjun's fix is merged.
sentences.zh: Arjun 的修复一合并，我们就上线。

sentences.en: Then I'll tell the client.
sentences.zh: 然后我去通知客户。

sentences.en: Last week we were behind schedule.
sentences.zh: 上周我们进度还落后。

sentences.en: But today we're right on track.
sentences.zh: 不过今天完全按计划走。

sentences.en: The fix is on the way.
sentences.zh: 修复马上就来。
sentences.speaker: Arjun

sentences.en: I'll get back to you when the tests pass — probably in about an hour.
sentences.zh: 测试一通过我就回你们——大概一个小时吧。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 很好。
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: I won't sign off on anything until QA says it's OK.
sentences.zh: QA 不点头，我什么都不签字放行。

sentences.en: So please keep me posted.
sentences.zh: 所以有进展请随时告诉我。

sentences.en: Fingers crossed!
sentences.zh: 祈祷一切顺利！

sentences.en: Hold on — I've just found a small bug on older phones.
sentences.zh: 等一下——我刚在老款手机上发现一个小 bug。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: When you turn the phone sideways, our old friend the Save button disappears again.
sentences.zh: 把手机横过来，咱们的老朋友「保存」按钮又不见了。

sentences.en: At the last minute, of course!
sentences.zh: 又是最后一刻，果然！
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: I hope it's a quick fix, because we're going live at two.
sentences.zh: 希望好修，我们两点就要上线了。

sentences.en: Can you sort it out before the tests finish?
sentences.zh: 你能在测试跑完之前搞定吗？

sentences.en: I'll take it on.
sentences.zh: 交给我吧。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: It'll probably take twenty minutes, and I'll message you as soon as it's done.
sentences.zh: 大概要二十分钟，一修好我就给你发消息。

sentences.en: Tests passed!
sentences.zh: 测试通过了！
sentences.speaker: Arjun

sentences.en: Sorry if I'm slow today, by the way — my Wi-Fi keeps cutting out.
sentences.zh: 对了，今天我回得慢的话见谅——我这边 Wi-Fi 老是断。

sentences.en: Bug fixed!
sentences.zh: bug 修好了！
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I've followed up with QA.
sentences.zh: 我已经找 QA 跟进了。

sentences.en: They're double-checking everything now.
sentences.zh: 他们正在把所有东西再核对一遍。

sentences.en: Good, because I've booked a table for dinner at eight.
sentences.zh: 那就好，我订了今晚八点的餐厅。
sentences.speaker: Arjun

sentences.en: If we find another bug, my wife will never forgive me.
sentences.zh: 要是再冒出一个 bug，我老婆永远不会原谅我。

sentences.en: QA have approved it, so I'm signing off.
sentences.zh: QA 批了，我这就签字放行。
sentences.speaker: Rachel

sentences.en: We're live!
sentences.zh: 我们上线了！

sentences.en: Thank you, everyone — I'm so proud of this team.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家——我真为这个团队骄傲。

sentences.en: Hi all, Sophie from Marketing here.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是市场部的 Sophie。
sentences.speaker: Sophie

sentences.en: Great news!
sentences.zh: 好消息！

sentences.en: We announced it yesterday, and the post already has two thousand likes.
sentences.zh: 我们昨天就发了公告，那条帖子已经有两千个赞了。

sentences.en: Yesterday?!
sentences.zh: 昨天？！
sentences.speaker: Rachel

cards.note: if a product, website or system goes live, people can start using it
cards.tip: 上线之后的状态用 be live：We're live! / The app is live. go 的过去式 went：It went live last night。
cards.example: The new checkout page goes live on Monday.

cards.note: 把分支合进主干：merge a branch / a pull request。
later than planned
cards.tip: 反义是 ahead of schedule；按计划进行是 on schedule 或 on track。
cards.example: We're a week behind schedule because of the API changes.

cards.note: making good progress and likely to finish on time
cards.tip: on track for sth 说「有望按时完成某事」；偏离计划是 off track。right 加在前面表示「完全」。
cards.example: Are we still on track for the Friday release?

cards.note: while you are going somewhere
to reply to someone later, by phone, email or message
cards.tip: to 不能丢：get back to sb；回复时间常跟在后面：get back to you by Friday。
cards.example: I'll check the logs and get back to you.

cards.note: to give official approval to something
cards.tip: 不带宾语时去掉 on：I'm signing off.（我批了。）sign off 另一个意思是「（邮件、节目）结束、落款」。
cards.example: The manager has to sign off on the budget first.

cards.note: quality assurance 的缩写，常指测试团队，按字母读 Q-A。
to keep telling someone the latest news about something
cards.tip: 人放中间：keep me / you / everyone posted；常用在一件事还没结束的时候，比 tell me 更口语。
cards.example: The client is still deciding — I'll keep you posted.

cards.note: 交叉手指是西方祈求好运的手势，说一句 Fingers crossed! 就是「但愿顺利」。
used to ask someone to wait for a short time
手机横屏也叫 landscape，竖屏叫 portrait。
at the latest possible time, just before something happens
cards.tip: 常带「太晚了、来不及」的抱怨语气；当形容词用要加连字符：a last-minute change。
cards.example: The client changed the design at the last minute.

cards.note: to organise something that is untidy, or to deal with a problem
to accept a job or a responsibility
used to add something, often on a different subject

cards.zh: （声音、信号）断断续续；突然中断
cards.note: if a sound or a machine cuts out, it suddenly stops working for a short time
to contact someone again, or do more, after something has happened
cards.tip: 跟进某人用 with，跟进某事用 on：follow up on the bug。
cards.example: Could you follow up with the designer about the icons?

cards.note: to check something again to make sure it is correct
cards.tip: 中间有连字符，一个词；后面可以直接接宾语，也可以接 that 从句：double-check that the link works。
cards.example: Can you double-check the date before you send the invite?

cards.note: to arrange to have a table at a restaurant at a particular time
forgive sb for (doing) sth；过去式 forgave，过去分词 forgiven。
to feel pleased and satisfied about something you have done or own
名词是 announcement；announce a new product 发布新产品。
